results.title: Dakota Johnson grows impatient as Anne Hathaway directs photographers on Verity red carpet
results.description: Anne Hathaway commands the Verity red carpet, directing photographers with a loud count while Dakota Johnson grows visibly impatient, joking about leaving early. Despite the on-set banter, the actresses share a sweet moment as Dakota rubs Anne's baby bump. The film, set to release on October 2, features a complex narrative where Dakota's character must navigate the dark secrets of Verity Crawford, played by Hathaway.
